title: First Partial Derivatives of a Polynomial Function
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: For f(x, y) = x^3 y^2 - 4x^2 + 5y, find f_x(x, y) and f_y(x, y), and evaluate them at (1, 2).

steps.title: Compute f_x Treating y as Constant
steps.explanation: Differentiate with respect to x while keeping y constant.
steps.why: Finding partial derivative with respect to x.

steps.title: Compute f_y Treating x as Constant
steps.explanation: Differentiate with respect to y while keeping x constant.
steps.why: Finding partial derivative with respect to y.
